People: William Shakespeare (author, Wikidata Q692), died 1616; William George Clark (editor, Wikidata Q8009776), died 1878; William Aldis Wright (editor, Wikidata Q8004238), died 1914. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Shakespeare, William, 1564-1616; Clark, William George, 1821-1878 [Editor]; Wright, William Aldis, 1831-1914 [Editor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Shakespeare: The Complete Dramatic and Poetic Works of William Shakespeare, John C. Winston Co., 1926, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/shakespearecompl0000will. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 71%, 83%, 75% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of William George Clark, William Aldis Wright, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
